decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo between Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to generate infinite mana and recycle spells from the graveyard. By using cards like Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble, the deck can further fuel this combo and enable the player to repeatedly cast spells. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Thassa's Oracle provide alternate win conditions.

The deck focuses on using cards like Architects of Will, Violent Outburst, and Living End to quickly cycle through the deck and bring out powerful creatures like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries from the graveyard. By utilizing Street Wraith and Force of Negation to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and win through a combination of efficient card draw and powerful creatures. The inclusion of Waker of Waves and Generous Ent provides additional options for gaining advantage and closing out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful colorless spells like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes various search and control cards like Chromatic Sphere, Relic of Progenitus, and Oblivion Stone to help maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the help of Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats.

This deck utilizes a combination of powerful control spells and creatures to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to control the opponent's spells and The One Ring to generate additional mana, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. With a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, along with powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, the deck can quickly take over the game and secure a victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Grief and Thoughtseize are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Terminate provide removal options. Feign Death and Undying Malice offer ways to protect key creatures and generate additional value. The deck also includes some unique cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers. It also utilizes powerful cards like The One Ring and Elesh Norn to dominate the board state. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the spells in the deck. Overall, the goal of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, establish board control, and eventually win the game through powerful threats and strategic play.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, creating a toolbox of options to control the board or combo off. Utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide, the deck can generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy while building its own win condition. The deck also includes cards like Zulaport Cutthroat and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons for additional ways to win the game through draining the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this Modern Merfolk Aggro deck is to utilize the synergies between cards that boost Merfolk creatures, like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, along with disruptive cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper to maintain board control and pressure opponents. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures and utilize cards like Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls to protect against removal while applying consistent pressure with evasive creatures. The inclusion of Force of Negation provides additional protection against opposing spells and combos.

The deck focuses on controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's strategy with a mix of removal spells and counterspells. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler to generate card advantage and protect its own threats. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and The One Ring helps to lock down the opponent's resources. The deck also has a strong creature base with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to apply pressure and stabilize the board. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This red deck wins archetype focuses on fast and aggressive creature and burn spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The deck utilizes efficient and direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm to pressure the opponent while creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear deal consistent damage. The deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex to disrupt opponent's strategies and prevent them from gaining life. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with relentless aggression and finish the game quickly before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to be aggressive with cheap, efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to establish early board presence with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also utilizes cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker to further disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this Rakdos Aggro deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Mine, and Power Plant) to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. It uses colorless artifacts and spells to control the board and search for key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck can quickly ramp up to play powerful threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger or Wurmcoil Engine. Jegantha, the Wellspring can be used as a companion, adding additional mana generation and flexibility to the deck. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with high-cost, powerful cards while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast powerful spells such as Karn Liberated and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to tutor for specific lands, ensuring that the UrzaTron is assembled efficiently. Additionally, cards like Oblivion Stone and Warping Wail provide additional control options to handle various situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to dominate the game, with a heavy emphasis on countering opponent's spells and removing threats from the board. It also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to provide additional control and card advantage. The inclusion of key cards like Leyline Binding and The One Ring helps to lock down the opponent's options, while cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation provide a powerful win condition. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's control strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The key idea of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with cheap artifact creatures and take advantage of cards like Cranial Plating and Shadowspear to turn them into powerful threats. The deck also includes a number of card draw and mana ramp spells to ensure a consistent flow of threats onto the battlefield. The artifact lands and Urza's Saga help to power out multiple threats early in the game, while Welding Jar and Relic of Progenitus provide some protection against removal and graveyard strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play Death's Shadow and other efficient threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage while also utilizing synergies with Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also has a combo finish with Underworld Breach and Orcish Bowmasters to close out the game quickly. The key strategy is to leverage the power of Death's Shadow and other aggressive threats to overwhelm the opponent while disrupting their plans.
